item.title: Euler V2 balances observed across four Coinbase B20 stocks on Base
item.description: DefiLlama asset pages for Coinbase Tokenized Stocks on Base show Euler V2 DeFi Active TVL of $1,236 for NVDAc, $936 for METAc, $863 for GOOGLc, and $738 for AAPLc, or about $3,773 combined. Base's official stock ecosystem page describes Euler as modular lending and borrowing for tokenized stocks. The footprint remains very small, and the exact vault configuration, utilization, supply/borrow APYs, and any B20-specific incentives were not independently verified.

item.title: Forge adds 10 Base stock tokens as pair assets as BASEOS/AMZNc goes live
item.description: Forge Launchpad says AMZNc, TSLAc, GOOGLc, SNDKc, MSTRc, NVDAc, SPCXc, METAc, MSFTc and AAPLc are now available as Base pair assets with dividend capabilities. A live BASEOS/AMZNc Uniswap V4 pool is also visible, with roughly $4.27K of liquidity and about $520 of 24-hour volume at observation time. The setup extends tokenized stocks beyond standalone holdings, collateral and conventional LP legs into quote assets for third-party tokens and holder-reward designs.

item.title: Aerodrome GOOGLc/WETH displayed APY rebounds from 124% to 226%, highlighting rapid yield whipsaw
item.description: On Base, DefiLlama's exact-pool page for Aerodrome Slipstream GOOGLc/WETH displayed $151,307 TVL and 226.46% APY at 2026-09-07 14:19 JST, split into 91.55% base and 134.92% AERO reward. At 13:02 JST the same opportunity had been recorded at $148,422 TVL and 124.39% APY, split into 66.35% base and 58.04% reward. TVL rose only about 1.9% while displayed APY increased 102.07 percentage points, or about 82.1% relative.

item.title: Aerodrome GOOGLc/WETH displayed APY compresses from 196% to 124% in roughly two hours
item.description: On Base, DefiLlama's displayed APY for the Aerodrome Slipstream GOOGLc/WETH pool fell from 195.80% at 2026-09-07 10:47 JST to 124.39% at 13:02 JST. TVL declined only about 1.8%, from $151,089 to $148,422, while the displayed components both contracted: base from 92.24% to 66.35% and AERO reward from 103.56% to 58.04%.

item.title: Aerodrome GOOGLc/WETH displayed APY re-expands from 97% to 196% with TVL nearly flat
item.description: On Base, DefiLlama's RWA surface shows Aerodrome Slipstream GOOGLc/WETH at $151,089 TVL and 195.80% APY, split into 92.24% base yield and 103.56% AERO rewards. The prior observation at 2026-09-06 23:51:27 JST showed $148,085 TVL and 97.01% APY, split into 38.80% base and 58.21% rewards. TVL increased only about 2% while displayed APY rose 98.79 percentage points to roughly twice the prior level.

item.title: Aerodrome wtCOIN/USDC displayed APY jumps above 2,194%
item.description: The ST0x wtCOIN/USDC Aerodrome Slipstream pool on Base is showing 2,194.44% APY on DeFiLlama, comprising 2,064.98% base APY from trading fees and 129.46% in AERO rewards, with about $43.3K of TVL. The most recent comparable RenditeMonitor snapshot available to this observation showed 583.22% APY and about $49K TVL, indicating a sharp rise in the displayed annualized rate.

item.title: Aerodrome's NVDAc and GOOGLc WETH pairs scale beyond launch-stage liquidity
item.description: On Base, Aerodrome Slipstream's NVDAc/WETH and GOOGLc/WETH pools have grown from small launch-stage pools to roughly $150,000 of liquidity each, creating a tokenized-stock LP route that does not use USDC. DefiLlama shows NVDAc/WETH at $146,594 TVL and 194.65% APY, split into 63.11% base and 131.54% AERO rewards. Its GOOGLc RWA surface shows GOOGLc/WETH at $148,085 TVL and 97.01% APY, split into 38.80% base and 58.21% AERO rewards.

item.title: Clearstar cbAssets TVL rises to $36.3M as USDC incentive APR falls to 3.42%
item.description: On Base, the latest Morpho campaign detail surface for Clearstar cbAssets V2 shows $36.3M TVL, 7.33% total APR (3.91% protocol + 3.42% Merkl), about $3.4K in daily rewards, and 2 active / 0 upcoming campaigns. Versus the immediately prior patrol reading of $33.67M TVL, 7.61% total APR and 3.69% Merkl APR, displayed TVL is higher by about $2.63M or 7.8%, while total APR is lower by 0.28 percentage points and the Merkl component by 0.27 points. Displayed daily rewards remain about $3.4K.

item.title: REBASE on Base Converts Trading Tax Into a Tokenized-Stock-Heavy Reward Basket
item.description: REBASE on Base describes a structure in which a 5% tax is charged on each trade and 3% is converted on-chain into a 10-asset basket that is automatically distributed to holders. At observation time, six of the ten slots were ST0x stock or ETF tokens: wtNVDA, wtIAU, wtCOIN, wtDRAM, wtQQQM and wtSPCX, each at 10%. The public interface displayed about $7.4K distributed in total, roughly $1.8K of 24-hour volume, a $50.9K market cap, 281 holders and about $21.7K of liquidity.

item.title: o1 Launchpad Extends Stock-Quoted Markets Across Base's Six Second-Wave Tokenized Stocks
item.description: o1 Launchpad markets on Base now use all six second-wave Coinbase Tokenized Stocks — AMZNc, MSFTc, MSTRc, SNDKc, SPCXc and TSLAc — as quote assets for B20 tokens. The six non-synchronous pool snapshots retrieved for this observation total roughly $175,000 in liquidity and $641,000 in 24-hour volume. The composition extends tokenized-stock use beyond USDC liquidity and collateral into pricing and settlement assets for other onchain tokens.

item.title: Aerodrome USDC liquidity now spans all six second-wave Base tokenized stocks
item.description: Aerodrome Slipstream 3 USDC pools are now observable for MSFTc, SNDKc and TSLAc, extending the second-wave Coinbase Tokenized Stock pool set beyond the previously confirmed AMZNc, MSTRc and SPCXc. The three newly observed pools show about $454,794 of combined displayed liquidity and about $1.572 million of combined 24-hour volume. No durable APY or independently confirmed AERO, Merkl or Beefy incentive has been established for the three newly observed pools.

item.title: Stockify expands its B20 dividend index to five assets with a 20% SPCXc allocation
item.description: Stockify's Base dividend index, which converts trading fees into B20 tokenized equities and pushes them to eligible holders, has expanded from four assets at the prior observation to five. SPCXc (SpaceX) was added at a 20% target weight, while NVDAc, AAPLc, GOOGLc and METAc moved from 25% each to 20% each. The official distribution desk now shows 388 settled cycles, $83,090.74 and 253.07 shares distributed in total, and 375 eligible holders.

item.title: SPCXc/USDC liquidity fragments as a 5% fee pool forms on Uniswap V4
item.description: A new 5% fee SPCXc/USDC pool is visible on Uniswap V4 on Base alongside the existing Aerodrome market. At observation time, the Uniswap V4 pool showed $18,860.87 of liquidity, $25,898.56 of 24-hour volume, 284 transactions and an age of roughly six hours. On the same GeckoTerminal surface, the related Aerodrome SPCXc/USDC market showed roughly $11,420 of liquidity and $380,960 of 24-hour volume, materially below the $44,954.13 liquidity recorded for Aerodrome at 03:43 JST on 2026-09-05.

item.title: Aerodrome METAc/USDC Display APY Falls to 582% as the AERO Reward Spike Normalizes
item.description: On Base, DeFi Terminal now shows Aerodrome Slipstream USDC-METAc at 581.51% APY, composed of 79.29% base yield and 502.22% reward yield, with roughly $857.6K in TVL. That is 1,256.49 percentage points below the 1,838.00% reading observed on the same surface on 2026-09-04 at 11:26 JST, with most of the move coming from the AERO reward component. The current reading is close to the page's 30-day average of 594.14%.

item.title: Base Expands Tokenized Stocks to Ten as a Second Wave of Aerodrome USDC Pools Forms
item.description: Base's official Coinbase Tokenized Stocks list has expanded from the original NVDAc, METAc, AAPLc and GOOGLc cohort to ten names, adding AMZNc, MSFTc, MSTRc, SNDKc, SPCXc and TSLAc. This observation also found live Aerodrome Slipstream 3 USDC pools with trading activity for AMZNc, MSTRc and SPCXc. The new pools remain thin, and no reliable public APY or independently confirmed AERO, Merkl or Beefy incentive for the second-wave names was identified at the observation time.

item.title: AERO-Driven APY Re-Expands in Aerodrome's METAc/USDC Pool
item.description: DefiLlama's METAc RWA dashboard now shows the Aerodrome Slipstream USDC-METAc pool on Base at 2,696.82% APY and $709,974 TVL. The displayed APY consists of 111.41% base yield and 2,585.41% in AERO rewards, up 2,092.94 percentage points from the 603.88% reading observed on the exact pool page at 2026-09-04 11:26 JST. DeFi Terminal, however, shows the same pool at 1,838.00% APY and about $702,300 TVL, indicating continued divergence across data surfaces.

item.title: Aerodrome METAc/USDC display APY re-expands to 1,838% while DefiLlama shows 604%
item.description: Aerodrome Slipstream METAc/USDC on Base displayed 1,838.00% APY on DeFi Terminal, split into 93.90% base yield and 1,744.11% reward yield, with about $702,300 TVL. The exact DefiLlama pool page simultaneously showed 603.88% APY, split into 52.68% base and 551.20% AERO rewards, with $904,280 TVL. Rewards dominate the headline yield, while the gap between two views described as DefiLlama-derived has widened to 1,234.12 percentage points.

item.title: Bitwise Mag7X Tokenized-Stock Portfolio Carries a 10% APR USDC Incentive
item.description: The Bitwise-designed, Glider-executed Mag7X Automated Token Portfolio is live on Base, and Merkl shows a 10% APR USDC incentive with about $508,000 in eligible TVL. The structure differs from a single-stock vault or LP: tokenized equities remain in a self-custodied portfolio that is automatically rebalanced, with an external reward layered on top.

item.title: Reward-driven APY on Aerodrome METAc/USDC re-expands to 826%
item.description: Aerodrome Slipstream METAc/USDC on Base showed 826.43% APY on DeFi Terminal, split into 66.24% base and 760.20% rewards, with about $927,400 TVL. DefiLlama's METAc RWA view still showed 657.17% APY and $945,928 TVL during the same observation window, highlighting a large update-timing gap even across views using the same underlying data.

item.title: New DiamondPepe/NVDAc market on Base extends tokenized stocks as quote assets
item.description: DiamondPepe/NVDAc is active as a new Uniswap V4 market on Base. GeckoTerminal showed roughly $47.6K-$58.5K liquidity and $2.02M-$2.03M of 24-hour volume, while DEX Screener showed about $47K liquidity but only $165K of volume. Both confirm the market, but the large provider discrepancy means headline turnover is not a settled figure.

item.title: A GOOGLc-quoted meme market gains real liquidity on Base
item.description: RAWR trades on Base against GOOGLc, Coinbase's tokenized Alphabet stock, using the equity token as the quote asset. RAWR's official site makes the GOOGLc denomination central to the market design. Market aggregators showed roughly $140,000 of liquidity and $400,000-$600,000+ of 24-hour volume, extending tokenized stocks into crypto-native price discovery.

item.title: LONG Uses Tokenized Stocks as Quote and Fee-Settlement Assets for Creator Key Markets on Base
item.description: LONG on Base lets Creator Keys tied to verified identities trade against tokenized stocks as quote assets. Its docs list 13 B20 stock tokens, including AAPLc, NVDAc and SPCXc. GeckoTerminal showed a kGOLONGFUN/NVDAc Uniswap v4 pool with about $17,009 liquidity and $654 of 24-hour volume, extending tokenized stocks into creator-market pricing and fee settlement.

item.title: Stockify converts trading fees into Base B20 equities and distributes them directly to holders
item.description: Stockify converts STFY trading fees into Coinbase B20 tokenized equities and distributes them to eligible holders. Its ETH/STFY Uniswap v4 market charges a 3% hook fee, with 90% directed to equity acquisition. The active index was 25% each NVDAc, AAPLc, GOOGLc and METAc; the distribution desk showed 317 settled cycles and $69,736.08 distributed.

item.title: A Fee-Heavy Aerodrome LP for ST0x's Tokenized NVIDIA Asset Emerges on Base
item.description: An Aerodrome Slipstream USDC/wtNVDA pool adds a parallel ST0x tokenized-equity lane on Base. DeFi Terminal showed 86.26% APY, split into 57.65% base and 28.61% rewards, with about $31,800 TVL. DefiLlama showed 131.37% APY and about $28,642 TVL, highlighting a material refresh or aggregation gap.

item.title: NVDAc Emerges as a Quote Asset for a Meme Token Market on Base
item.description: A Uniswap V4 market on Base pairs BLUECHIP directly with NVDAc, Coinbase's tokenized NVIDIA stock. BLUECHIP's official site identifies the BLUECHIP/NVDAc pair on o1 Launchpad, while a nearby GeckoTerminal snapshot showed roughly $476,000 in liquidity and about $1.0 million in 24-hour volume. The structure shows a tokenized equity being used not merely as a stock-linked asset or USDC LP component, but as the quote asset for another speculative token.

item.title: Reading the Tomb Fork Boom in Numbers: From Money Printer to Graveyard
item.description: A reconstruction of 177 depeg episodes across Fantom Tomb forks, separating liquidity, selling, share-token behavior and recovery paths to ask why most depegs recovered while a few did not.

item.title: Aerodrome Tokenized-Stock LP Rewards Re-Expand Across AAPLc, METAc and GOOGLc
item.description: Displayed yields on Aerodrome Slipstream tokenized-stock/USDC pools expanded again. AAPLc showed 375.31% APY with about $1.16 million TVL, METAc 657.17% with about $946,000 TVL and GOOGLc 349.84% with about $1.32 million TVL, with rewards accounting for most of the increase.

item.title: Aerodrome NVDAc LP Rebounds Above 300% APY After a Sharp Drop
item.description: Aerodrome Slipstream USDC-NVDAc on Base rebounded from roughly 58% APY in the prior patrol to above 300%. DeFi Terminal showed 351.08% and DefiLlama 314.43%, while TVL fell from about $2.0 million to roughly $1.65-$1.70 million.

item.title: Base Tokenized-Stock Incentives Expand from LP Rewards to Direct Cashback
item.description: Coinbase Tokenized Stocks on Base are now being incentivized through direct USDC cashback for purchases held through an epoch, without requiring an LP or vault. Merkl listed up to 5% cashback via 1inch and up to 2% through Reserve and Definitive across AAPLc, GOOGLc, NVDAc and METAc opportunities.

item.title: From Asset to DeFi Primitive: The Tokenized-Stock Yield Market Emerging on Base
item.description: Tokenized equities on Base are rapidly becoming collateral, LP inventory, carry inputs and vault components. The structural change matters more than the headline APYs.

item.title: Aerodrome Tokenized-Stock LP APYs Unwind Rapidly from Four Digits
item.description: The extreme APYs previously observed on Aerodrome Slipstream tokenized-stock pools fell sharply in newer data. RenditeMonitor showed AAPLc/USDC at 164.55%, NVDAc/USDC at 467.69% and GOOGLc/USDC at 140.25%, while other DefiLlama surfaces still displayed materially different values.

item.title: Aerodrome Tokenized-Stock LPs Show Four-Digit APYs
item.description: Aerodrome Slipstream tokenized-stock/USDC pools on Base showed another sharp yield spike. DefiLlama displayed AAPLc/USDC at 1,450.92%, NVDAc/USDC at 1,374.37% and GOOGLc/USDC at 954.33%, with AERO rewards accounting for most of each figure.

item.title: Beefy USDC–GOOGLc Shows 47.09% APY on DefiLlama
item.description: DefiLlama showed Beefy USDC–GOOGLc on Base at 47.09% APY with about $284,000 in TVL. The yield depends on Aerodrome liquidity provision plus external incentives rather than swap fees alone.

item.title: Aerodrome GOOGLc/USDC APY Spikes as TVL Falls About 89%
item.description: Aerodrome Slipstream GOOGLc/USDC on Base rose from a prior observed APY of 96.60% to 412.17% while TVL fell from about $1.4 million to $157,000. The displayed yield split was 105.56% base and 306.61% rewards.

item.title: Is Robinhood Chain’s TVL Surge Really User Growth—or Capital Arriving First?
item.description: Examining the timing gap between capital formation and user growth through TVL, stablecoins, Morpho and active-address data.

item.title: Making the Same Dollar Work Twice: Twofold and the Rise of Capital-Reuse DeFi
item.description: Reading DualPool as an early-stage capital-reuse primitive while separating deployment evidence from still-unverified TVL, fee and harvest claims.
